# Primegen Trading Corporation

> Primegen Trading Corporation supplies steel bars, pipes, fittings, roofing, fencing, PPE, and other construction materials to contractors and builders across Cavite and the Philippines.

Primegen is a construction-materials supplier based in Imus, Cavite, Philippines. It sells direct-from-supplier (no markup layers), offers scheduled delivery windows, and assigns a dedicated coordinator to confirm every order. It serves contractors and builders nationwide across the Philippines.
